query: Recent French 2027 presidential first-round voting intention polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June-July 2026, with pollster, fieldwork dates, and Le Pen percentage. Include Ifop, Harris Interactive, Toluna, Elabe, Odoxa, IFOP polls.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of my findings on French 2027 presidential first-round polls testing Marine Le Pen by name in June–July 2026:

## Key Findings

**Marine Le Pen declared her 2027 candidacy on July 7, 2026** (TF1 evening news), triggering a wave of polls testing her by name. The three most recent post-declaration polls cluster her at **34–36%**, consistently leading the first round:

| Pollster | Client | Fieldwork/Date | Le Pen % |
|----------|--------|----------------|----------|
| **Ifop** | LCI / Le Figaro | ~July 7–8 (pub. July 8) | **36%** (both scenarios) |
| **Harris Interactive** (Toluna Harris) | — | July 9 | **34–36%** (5 scenarios) |
| **Elabe** | BFMTV | July 9–10 (pub. July 12) | **34–35.5%** (5 scenarios) |

**Pre-declaration June polls** (where Le Pen was tested by name in some scenarios):
- **Ipsos-BVA** (June 1): 31–32%
- **Ifop** (June 25): 32% (scenarios 4–5; mostly tested Bardella)
- **OpinionWay** (June 14): tested Bardella, not Le Pen by name in recorded scenarios

## Trajectory
Named-Le Pen first-round support **rose from ~31–32% (early June, pre-declaration) to 34–36% (mid-July, post-declaration)** — Ifop and Elabe both attributed a ~3–4 point "declaration effect." She leads well ahead of Édouard Philippe (~16–20%), Mélenchon (~14.5–16%), and Attal (~13.5–16%), and wins all tested second-round matchups.

## Important caveats
- **"Toluna" and "Harris Interactive" are the same institute** (Toluna Harris Interactive).
- I found **no standalone June–July 2026 Odoxa** first-round poll testing Le Pen by name (most recent Odoxa was March 26, 2026, testing Bardella).
- The most recent **Toluna-branded** first-round poll located was April 28–30, 2026 (sample 1,725 registered voters).
- Fieldwork dates for some polls are approximate; sample sizes were not consistently disclosed in aggregator sources.
